description: Records connected to a record. via="topics": most similar records by shared topics (returns shared_topics). via="links" (default), depth=1: direct links (an artist's works, groups, videos; a group's members). depth=2: records connected through a shared neighbour (e.g. artists sharing a group or an artwork with X), ranked by how many links they share.

types.description: Limit to these record types: artist, theorist, group, space, artwork, video, annotation, post, contributor.

via.description: "links" (default) = stored links; "topics" = most similar records by shared topics.
